title: OWLS: Scaling Laws for Multilingual Speech Recognition and Translation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Word Error Rate (WER), Character Error Rate (CER), and BLEU scores across 150 languages to measure the performance gap between high-resource and low-resource languages. The paper also assesses dialect bias by comparing error rates between dominant and minority dialects, specifically evaluating performance on Mainland Chinese (zh-CN) versus Taiwanese Mandarin (zh-TW).
